name: glb-designer-stage1a
description: Asset Studio Stage 1a — the new profile-driven shape kinds (lathe/extrude/sweep) + ubiquitous bevels in the GLB designer. In Pro with glbDesigner on: add a Lathe (seeds the turned-leg preset), an Extrude (rounded-rect, bevel ON by default), a Sweep (piping ring) and a Box, then bevel the box via its 'Corner radius' slider. Asserts 4 parts via the designer's own layer-row Remove buttons (scoped to .glb-designer). Then selects the lathe, reads its first profile point's X input, sets it to a distinctive value (0.234) through the ProfileEditor numeric field, and asserts the input reflects it — a DOM readback of the part's live `profile` param (the input is bound to part.profile[sel][0], so the new value only appears if the edit round-tripped through updatePart → re-render). Finally saves and asserts the persisted UserGltfDef's `assetSpec` JSON contains that 0.234 coordinate AND all four Stage-1a kinds (lathe/extrude/sweep) — the end-to-end proof the geometry params reached the exported spec. Screenshots the decisive frames (all four shapes framed by the Bounds fit; the bevelled box; the restored/edited profile). Part rows counted with `.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]`.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on
steps.failMessage: glbDesigner is a pro-tier flag → on in Pro mode by default

steps.name: wait-designer
steps.failMessage: designer dialog should mount with the flag on in Pro mode

steps.name: wait-lathe
steps.failMessage: adding a Lathe should append a lathe layer row

steps.name: assert-four-parts
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (n !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 shape parts, got ' + n); })()

steps.name: bevel-the-box
steps.comment: The box is the selected part (add-shape auto-selects). Drive its 'Corner radius' slider to a visible fillet.
steps.eval: (function(){ const sl = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer input[type=range]')].find(i => i.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Corner radius (m)'); if (!sl) throw new Error('Corner radius slider not found for the box'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(sl), 'value').set; setter.call(sl, '0.08'); sl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: select-lathe
steps.comment: Click the lathe layer row to select it (opens its PartInspector with the ProfileEditor).
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const row = rows.find(r => /lathe 1/i.test(r.textContent || '')); if (!row) throw new Error('lathe layer row not found'); row.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-profile-editor
steps.failMessage: selecting the lathe should show the shared ProfileEditor with numeric X/Y fields

steps.name: edit-profile-point-x
steps.comment: Set the selected profile point's X to a distinctive 0.234 via the numeric field — a param edit that must round-trip through updatePart back into part.profile.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Profile point X"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.234'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-profile-readback
steps.comment: DOM readback of the part's live param: the input is bound to part.profile[sel][0], so it shows 0.234 only if the edit reached the spec and re-rendered.
steps.eval: (function(){ const v = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Profile point X"]').value; if (Number(v) !== 0.234) throw new Error('profile point X should read back 0.234 after the numeric edit, got ' + v); if (v === window.__latheXBefore) throw new Error('profile point X did not change'); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage1a Shapes'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-spec-carries-params
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved UserGltfDef's assetSpec JSON carries all Stage-1a kinds AND the edited 0.234 profile coordinate.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage1a Shapes' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"lathe"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"extrude"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"sweep"') && d.assetSpec.includes('0.234'))

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed lathe/extrude/sweep parts and the edited 0.234 lathe profile coordinate
